title: Moran-matak Samaj Sanskriti (মৰাণ-মটক সমাজ সংস্কৃতি)
author: Dipen Maran (দীপেন মৰাণ)
description: Scholarly socio-cultural and historical study on the Moran and Matak communities in Upper Assam, examining their historical alliances and linguistic-cultural contact with the Tai-Ahom, Tai-Khamyang, and Tai-Khamti populations along the Burhi Dihing and Tengapani river valleys.
source: Tinsukia: Moran-Matak Historical Society, Archive ID: in.ernet.dli.2015.451545

sentences.text_roman: pap nai lat lawng poen lae yen ngae pi nawng mo ran ti a sam tawn noer
sentences.assamese_script: এই পুথিখনত উজনি অসমৰ মৰাণ-মটক সমাজৰ ইতিহাস আৰু লোকসংস্কৃতিৰ বিশদ আলোচনা কৰা হৈছে
sentences.free_translation_en: This book examines the historical trajectory and living culture of the Moran and Matak people in Upper Assam.
sentences.free_translation_as: এই পুথিখনত উজনি অসমৰ মৰাণ-মটক সমাজৰ ইতিহাস আৰু লোকসংস্কৃতিৰ বিশদ আলোচনা কৰা হৈছে।
sentences.speaker: Dipen Maran (দীপেন মৰাণ)
sentences.notes: Upper Assam ethnohistory and indigenous communities.
